description: Return HelloCPA Practice Management info — the standalone product at practice.hellobooks.ai for running a CPA / CA / bookkeeping practice (proposals + CPQ, workflow, time tracking, billing, 6-role RBAC, Gmail/Outlook/Calendar sync, CSV migration from TaxDome / Karbon / Canopy).
